blocks.html: Planning to go on a staycation during the holidays? Summit Hotels & Resorts got you covered with their awesome promos.

From December 1, 2018 to March 1, 2019, you can book an overnight stay or a 2-night stay at any Summit Hotel for a special price. Create lasting memories with your loved ones as you stay in the hotel’s Super Rooms and enjoy a cozy breakfast for two. Plus, you can also make use of the hotel’s superb amenities while on vacation.

Excited? Then start booking from December 1, 2018 until March 1, 2019. Set your most-awaited holiday staycation at Summit Hotel Magnolia as you book a one night stay for only ₱3,200.00nett per room or a two night stay for only ₱6,200.00nett per room.

For those planning to visit the Queen City of the South, Summit Circle Cebu offers an exclusive overnight stay for only ₱2,400.00nett per room and a two night stay for only ₱4,600.00nett per room. Retreat into the lap of luxury at Summit Galleria Cebu as you enjoy a one-night stay for ₱3,500.00nett per room or a two night stay for ₱6,800.00nett per room.
Make celebrations more special when you stay at Summit Hotel Tacloban. Book a one night stay in Tacloban’s largest hotel for only ₱3,200.00nett per room or for two nights at ₱6,200.00nett per room.

Finally, marvel at the stunning view of Taal Volcano when you relish your time away at Summit Ridge Tagaytay. Book a one night stay for only ₱3,500.00nett per room from Sundays to Wednesdays. From Thursdays to Saturdays, you can avail of the promo for only ₱4,000.00nett. If you want to extend your stay for 1 more day, then avail of their two night stay package for only ₱6,800.00nett per room from Sundays to Wednesdays. Likewise, you can avail of the promo from Thursdays to Saturdays for only ₱7,800.00nett per room.
Make the most of your time with your family as you spend special moments this holidays at Summit Hotels & Resorts with their amazing deals.
